topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: The design of SIW arrays for high-gain inter-satellite antennas involves a critical trade-off between array size and radiation efficiency. As the array size increases, the radiation efficiency tends to decrease due to higher insertion loss and substrate transmission line loss. However, larger arrays can provide higher radiation efficiency and gain. To achieve optimal radiation efficiency and minimize insertion loss, the design must carefully balance the scaling of line lengths, substrate material properties, and power divider topology. Precise simulation and experimental validation are essential to ensure the best performance in high-gain inter-satellite antennas.
